svg.title: Sled (tp::sled): weight box, pan and push-down on soil

g.text: Sled (tp::sled): weight box, pan and push-down on soil
+box_max_mass_kg : double (what the box holds; adjusted() stays within it)
+box_start / box_end_ahead_of_wheels_m : double (start may be behind the wheels)
+wheel_rolling_losses : double (the tires' own, on top of 1/Bn)
+loads(const Params&, const State&, const HookForce&, const Ground&) : Loads
+predict(const State&, const Params&, resistance_n, dt_s) : Prediction
+kPanHalfWidth_m : double = 1 (where the pan meets a track's spots)
pan = (W_frame x_frame + W_box x_box - F_up x_hook + F_fwd h_hook) / x_pan
the box moves forward with the distance travelled;
the push-down moves the wheels' share onto the pan over its ramp;
pan friction μ = μ_pan (1 + plough · p / CI), p = pan load / pan area;
knives = 0.2 · min(CI, 2 MPa) · count · width · depth (while the pan carries load);
berm: dM = share · ρ · thrown · dt, spilling M · v dt / spill distance; drag μ_berm · M · g;
resistance = μ pan + knives + berm + towed rolling (Brixius) wheels, holding but never pulling back;
adjusted(): the operator's change; heavier(): the pull-off sled, some steps heavier
sideways, a trailer on the chain: hook pull, rear wheels' side grip
(relaxation length), pan friction against its sliding direction,
implicit; sliding forward, the pan resists sideways weakly: the dog-tail
